line: Commander, on your feet! A Hive swarm just dropped out of the dark, right across the convoy's course.
They don't take prisoners and they don't bargain. Every gun we have: weapons free!
Commander, we lost them. The swarm tore through every ship in the convoy.
That swarm answered to Vael'Khor, the Hive Matriarch. She devours whole worlds, and now she knows our name.
Only our escape pods got clear. We came down on the nearest world we could reach, with nothing but the crew.
Commander. We made it, barely. The convoy is gone, and this world is all we have left.
Every planet here orbits the Void, a black hole at the heart of the galaxy. The Hive holds most of them.
We're not alone either. Other commanders orbit the Void, and any colony can change hands.
Now we rebuild, and we grow strong enough to end Vael'Khor. I'll post directives on the Base tab. Complete them and Fleet Command will send supplies.
Commander, first things first: what should the galaxy call you? Every commander sees this name. Type it and tap Save.
Commander, this world is ours now. Give our capital a name worthy of an empire, then tap Save.
Commander, everything starts with metal. Open Structures and build your first Metal Extractor.
Commander, extractors need power. A Solar Array keeps them running at full speed.
Commander, crystal pays for research and better hulls. Get a refinery going.
Commander, upgrades multiply your income. Jobs under five minutes finish for free: tap Free when it appears.
Commander, drones, ships and research all burn gas. Get a synthesizer running.
Commander, Drone Works speeds up every construction and unlocks the Shipyard. You'll find it under Facility.
Commander, no fleet, no empire. Build the Shipyard.
Commander, ships need engines, and engines need research. Build a Research Center under Facility.
Commander, Energy Technology is the root of the tech tree, and Combustion Drive needs it. Start it now.
Commander, Combustion Drive powers your first warships. Once it is done, the Shipyard can build Light Fighters.
Commander, Light Fighters are cheap and fast: perfect for your first raids. Queue three of them. Academy crews build them in a minute each.
Commander, never attack blind. Fleet Command just sent us four Espionage Probes. I've marked a weak Hive garrison near us: tap Espionage on its card and send the probes.
The probes made it in. Open the report in Mail: it counts the defenders and tells you if your fighters would win.
Commander, now we know what's waiting there. Send the fighters at that garrison and show Vael'Khor we bite back.
Commander, our fighters are under way. Find them on the Galaxy map and tap them: the camera follows your fleet and its control bar opens.
Commander, every minute in transit is a minute the Hive digs in. Tap ⚡ to light the afterburners: the rest of the trip is 50% faster. This first burn is on the Academy.
Commander, sit back now. Tap 🎥 and the camera rides in with your fighters, right into the fight.
Commander, our fighters are closing on the garrison. Win the fight and the report lands in Mail. If they lost, send them again.
Commander, resource fields pay out to whoever holds them. Fields already held by a rival must be fought for, so pick a free one.
Commander, derelict pyramid stations drift all over the map. Low-level vaults are unguarded: free shards and relics.
Every battle, espionage report and message lands in Mail. Replays show you exactly why you won or lost.
Commander, pirates hoard loot and drop rare items. This first crew is a small one: send every fighter you have.
Commander, crystal is the rarest thing we mine, and research runs on it. Take the Crystal Refinery to Lv.5: every level digs faster. The Academy covers the cost.

Commander, next goal: a second world. Astrophysics decides how many planets we can hold, and it needs Research Center Lv.3, Espionage Technology Lv.4 and Impulse Drive Lv.3. Start with the Research Center.
Commander, Impulse Drive speeds up Colony Ships and heavier hulls, and Astrophysics needs Lv.3. Find it under Engine Research.
Commander, better probes, and the last thing Astrophysics needs. Take Espionage Technology to Lv.4 under Advanced Research.
Commander, everything is in place. Start Astrophysics under Advanced Research: it charts stable orbits for settlers.
Commander, one more level and we can hold a second world. Every 2 levels of Astrophysics adds a planet, up to 10.
Never attack blind. Espionage Probes fly in, count the defenders and come home with a report. They need Shipyard Lv.3 and Espionage Technology Lv.2.
I've marked the weakest Hive world near us. Tap Espionage on its card and send your probes.
The probes are back. Open the report in Mail: it shows the defenders, their ships and the resources you could take home.
Now we know what's there. Send a fleet that outguns its garrison: the report shows exactly what you're up against.
Astrophysics Lv.2 lets us hold a second world. A Colony Ship needs Shipyard Lv.4 and Impulse Drive Lv.3.
Send the Colony Ship along with your warships to a Hive world you can beat. Win the battle and the world becomes ours: our second planet, and the first world we take back from Vael'Khor.
Our flagship is built from rare materials, and pirates hoard them. Raid another hideout: what they drop goes to the Flagship Dock. After that, the Academy clears you to build the Dock.
The Flagship Dock is where our flagship is commissioned and where its gear is forged. Find it under Structures → Facility.
Everything's ready, Commander. Commission the flagship: from now on it leads every fleet we send, gains experience and wears the gear the Dock forges.
Commander, clean work. That garrison won't trouble us for a while.
Vael'Khor felt that. Once your Academy training is done, expect her raiders over our homeworld.
Build defenses and keep some ships at home. Chapter 2: Hold the Line.
Commander, the worlds nearer the Void are richer, and the Hive guards them harder.
Check the tech tree in Research. Heavier hulls need lasers, ion and hyperspace tech. Chapter 3: Into the Reach.
Commander, scouts found Hive breeding grounds along the event rim. Leviathans guard them.
Plasma weapons and Reapers will break them. Chapter 4: Breaking the Hive.
That's the Academy done, Commander. Our flagship leads the fleet now: it earns experience in every fight, and the Flagship Dock forges its gear.
Every 2 Astrophysics levels lets us hold another world: build more Colony Ships and send them with escorts to Hive worlds we can beat. I'll keep pointing you at the next directive on your path.
And Commander: Fleet Command's supply convoy lands in 8 hours. Come back then and claim it on the Quests tab.
Commander, first blood! The garrison is broken, and Vael'Khor knows it.
Welcome back, Commander! The Academy is right where you left it, and Fleet Command sent supplies to get you moving again.

where: Economy · Upgrade the Solar Array to Lv.5
line: Commander, before we claim a second world, our first one has to run properly. Our extractors are starved for power: Structures shows a red Power shortage card. Rule one of a strong economy: power first. Take the Solar Array to Lv.5.

where: Economy · Upgrade the Metal Extractor to Lv.6
line: Commander, metal is what we spend the most: every hull and every building. So metal is always our highest extractor. Take it to Lv.6.

where: Economy · Upgrade the Solar Array to Lv.7
line: Commander, every extractor level draws more power. Whenever the Power shortage card turns red, the Solar Array comes next. Take it to Lv.7.

where: Economy · Upgrade the Crystal Refinery to Lv.6
line: Commander, crystal comes second: research and better hulls run on it. Keep it two levels behind metal. Take the Crystal Refinery to Lv.6.

where: Economy · Upgrade the Metal Extractor to Lv.8
line: Commander, back to metal. Metal Lv.8, Crystal Lv.6, Gas Lv.4: that is the balance strong empires run on. Take the Metal Extractor to Lv.8.

where: Economy · Upgrade the Solar Array to Lv.9
line: Commander, power again, before the gas. The Gas Synthesizer draws the most power of all, so the Solar Array goes to Lv.9 first.

where: Economy · Upgrade the Gas Synthesizer to Lv.4
line: Commander, gas fuels fleets and research, but we need less of it, so it stays lowest. Take it to Lv.4 and our pattern is complete: Metal 8, Crystal 6, Gas 4, with the Solar Array keeping up.

where: Economy · Upgrade your storage to Lv.2
line: Commander, our extractors now dig faster than we can store. When a silo is full, its extractor stops. Take the Metal Silo, the Crystal Vault and the Gas Tank to Lv.2 so nothing goes to waste.

Commander, a rich world draws raiders. A Radar Station spots enemy fleets on their way to us, earlier with every level. Build it under Facility. From now on, every world we hold gets the same order: power, metal, crystal, gas, storage, radar.
Commander, the Metal Extractor. Metal pays for almost everything we build, so keep this our highest extractor, about two levels above crystal.
Commander, the Crystal Refinery. Research and better hulls run on crystal. Keep it about two levels behind metal.
Commander, the Gas Synthesizer. Gas fuels every flight and most research. It draws the most power, so raise the Solar Array first.
Commander, the Solar Array powers every one of your extractors. When the Power shortage card turns red, upgrade this before anything else.
Commander, the Metal Silo. When it is full, the Metal Extractor stops. Raise it whenever metal sits at the cap.
Commander, the Crystal Vault. A full vault stops the refinery. Keep it ahead of your crystal income.
Commander, the Gas Tank: a full tank stops the synthesizer. Raise it as your gas income grows.
Commander, Drone Works. Every level speeds up all construction on this world. Keep it rising with your economy.
Commander, the Shipyard. Its Production tab builds ships, and its Repair tab rebuilds wrecks. Higher levels unlock heavier hulls.
Commander, the Research Center. Its Research tab opens the whole tech tree, and every level speeds research up.
Commander, the Radar Station. Its Warning tab shows enemy fleets on their way. Every level spots them five minutes sooner.
Commander, the Repair Yard. Ships wrecked in battle are towed home and rebuilt here, and it puts out fires on our worlds.
Commander, the Missile Silo stores interceptors that shoot down incoming missiles, and ballistic missiles that strike enemy defenses.
Commander, the Orbital Fortress fights for this world when it is attacked. Build it on the worlds we cannot afford to lose.
Commander, the Fusion Plant burns gas to make a lot of power. Use it when the Solar Array can't keep up, and watch your gas.
Commander, the Nanite Assembly halves every build time on this world with each level. It is the biggest speed-up we have.
Commander, the Geo-Former opens new ground: five more building fields per level. Build it when a world runs out of room.
Commander, the Coalition Depot fuels allied fleets and cuts the fuel of every flight. Its Fleets tab shows allies stationed here.
Commander, the Lunar Outpost opens building room on this world's moon. Every level adds three moon fields.
Commander, the Phalanx Array scans the space around this moon and adds a radar level for every level we build.
Commander, the Flagship Dock is where our flagship is commissioned and equipped. Its Flagship tab holds its gear.
Commander, the Warp Gate moves ships instantly between two gated worlds. It recharges after each jump.
Commander, Light Fighters are cheap, fast and the backbone of an early fleet. Build them in numbers.
Commander, Small Cargos carry plunder and supplies. Send them with your warships so a win brings the loot home.
Commander, Heavy Fighters carry real armour and shred Small Cargos. A strong step up from Light Fighters.
Commander, Large Cargos hold five Small Cargos' worth. Best for pirate raids and for moving resources between worlds.
Commander, Recyclers collect debris fields at full efficiency. Send them wherever a big battle just ended.
Commander, Pathfinders are fast long-range raiders with deep holds, deadly against Cruisers and fighters.
Commander, the Colony Ship settles a new world. Send it with warships against a Hive world we can beat, and that world becomes ours.
Commander, Cruisers are our fastest warships and the counter to any fighter swarm.
Commander, Battleships are heavy line ships: thick hulls, big guns, and deadly against Pathfinders.
Commander, Dreadnoughts hunt fleets. They punish lines of Battleships, Cruisers and Heavy Fighters.
Commander, Bombers break defenses. Send them at fortified worlds full of turrets.
Commander, Destroyers are escort killers, best against Dreadnoughts and Laser Turrets.
Commander, the Reaper is the king of the fleet. It hunts capital ships: Battleships, Bombers and Destroyers.
Commander, the Cube Destroyer is the rarest weapon in the galaxy. Only a very large fleet stands a chance against one.
Commander, Espionage Probes scout before every attack. Send more of them, or raise Espionage Technology, and the report shows more.
Commander, Mender Repair Ships patch up the fleet after every battle, and speed up the Repair Yard while parked at home.
Commander, the Guardian Heavy Cruiser is a flying shield wall that draws enemy fire away from smaller ships.
Commander, the Halo Escort Carrier launches fighter wings and protects the fleet. Deadly against fighters.
Commander, the Citadel Supercarrier is a mobile base: it commands fleets and launches squadrons.

Commander, some building cards hold more than an upgrade. Open the Shipyard: its Repair tab rebuilds ships wrecked in battle, and its Production tab is where every ship is built. The Research Center's Research tab works the same way.
Commander, the probes made it in. Open the report in Mail and I'll walk you through it: what's stored there, what's guarding it, and whether your fighters would win.
Commander, every battle lands in Mail with a full report. Open the report of your Hive victory and tap Watch the battle: the replay shows exactly why you won.
Commander, that's our homeworld balanced. Keep this order on every world we settle: power, metal, crystal, gas, storage, radar.
For stronger ships, follow the Fleet Path: every new hull needs a bigger Shipyard and new research, and its card shows the whole road with a tick for each step.
Commander, Energy Technology boosts every solar and fusion plant, and most other research needs it first.
Commander, Laser Technology arms our light weapons. Heavy Lasers and the bigger warships need it.
Commander, Ion Technology leads to Cruisers, Ion Cannons and Plasma Technology.
Commander, Hyperspace Technology adds cargo space, and unlocks the Hyperspace Drive and our heaviest warships.
Commander, Plasma Technology raises mine output a little every level, and unlocks Bombers and Plasma Turrets.
Commander, the Combustion Drive speeds up Light Fighters, cargo ships and Recyclers.
Commander, the Impulse Drive speeds up Heavy Fighters, Cruisers, Bombers and Colony Ships. Colony Ships need level 3 of it first.
Commander, the Hyperspace Drive speeds up Battleships and every capital ship. The road to the Reaper runs through it.
Commander, Espionage Technology decides how much our probes see, and how well we hide from theirs.
Commander, Computer Technology gives us one more fleet slot per level, so more fleets can fly at once.
Commander, Astrophysics lets us hold more planets: one more world for every two levels.
Commander, the Intergalactic Research Network links our labs, so every level makes research faster.
Commander, Graviton Technology is a capstone research for end-game fleets.
Commander, Weapons Technology adds ten percent damage to every ship and defense, per level.
Commander, Shielding Technology adds ten percent shield strength to every ship and defense, per level.
Commander, Armour Technology adds ten percent hull strength to every ship and defense, per level.
Commander, Cargo Logistics adds cargo space, so every raid and trade run carries home more.
Commander, Fleet Command lets our joint strikes hold more ships, and brings more allies to answer our calls.
Commander, Terraforming adds building fields on every planet we hold.
Commander, Fleet Repair Technology makes repairs faster and cheaper.
Our flagship is commissioned, Commander. It leads every fleet now, earns experience in every fight, and the Flagship Dock forges its gear.
Commander, the Discovery Class Destroyer is an alliance flagship, with no limit on how many you build. Its command aura lifts the whole fleet.
Commander, that's the Academy finished. From here, missions keep coming with my briefings, but you lead the way: no more pointers, and no more free speed-ups.
Commander, that's the Academy finished. Our flagship leads the fleet now: it earns experience in every fight, and the Flagship Dock forges its gear.
Commander, that's a Void Shark: a cruiser-sized predator with laser turrets bolted to its hide. Bring heavy hulls, and it drops Exotic Tissue for the forge.
Commander, Nebula Squids are fast, many-armed and hunt in packs. Bring Cruisers and armour. They drop Exotic Tissue, and sometimes Void Essence.
Commander, a Star Leviathan. Its jaws can split a battleship, so scout it first and send our heaviest fleet. It guards rare flagship materials.
Commander, a derelict pyramid station. Send an expedition to open its vault for shards, resources and rare items. From level 3, something guards the halls.
Commander, this Cube is a fortress, and one fleet rarely breaks it, so call a joint strike with our allies. Cubes drop Cube Fragments and Void Essence, the rarest materials in the forge.
Commander, the Super Cube is the prize of the galaxy. From Friday to Sunday, alliances fight to seize and hold it. Every minute our alliance holds it earns glory and rewards for every member.
